subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a half-orc cleric of Bahamut who has escaped multiple prisons.
source_quote: Here I am, Gyrgum, half-orc cleric of Bahamut, and Gracklstugh is what makes an orc camp look pretty. ... I seem to keep having to escape from some prison, whether it’s the prisons on the overbrite, or the prisons of the Drow, or the prisons of the Duergar.

subject: Themberchaud
fact: Themberchaud is a young red dragon known as the Wyrmsmith of Gracklstugh.
source_quote: It's Themberchaud, the Wyrmsmith of Gracklstugh

subject: Themberchaud
fact: Themberchaud claims the party are his agents bound by his protection.
source_quote: we are his “agents, bound by my protection."

subject: Themberchaud
fact: Themberchaud declares he will provide express service to where the party must go next.
source_quote: he offers his "express service to where you must go next"

subject: Themberchaud
fact: Themberchaud shouts at the party to climb aboard or question the will of the Wyrmsmith.
source_quote: Climb aboard, unless you wish to question the will of your wormsmith"

subject: Themberchaud
fact: Themberchaud proclaims the cavern he flies through is "my town".
source_quote: proclaiming it "my town"

subject: Themberchaud
fact: Themberchaud believes he is in charge of Gracklstugh, though he is merely a glorified lighter.
source_quote: It's clear that he "thinks he's in charge". Yet, I know the truth: he's merely a "glorified lighter" for the Duergar forges.

subject: Themberchaud
fact: Themberchaud breathes fire at a forge while declaring himself "Bringer of flame!".
source_quote: I am Themberchaud the Wyrmsmith, bringer of flame!"

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observes that Themberchaud is a very large but not very old dragon.
source_quote: A young dragon would not have enough space for our gang, but this is a very large dragon. Not a very old dragon, a very large dragon.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz uses Misty Step to avoid falling off Themberchaud during a sharp turn.
source_quote: And then I am falling. Not for long, that’s what Misty Step is for.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin agrees with Zalthir that they should have tied themselves to Themberchaud’s back.
source_quote: I agree with Zalthir that we really should have tied ourselves up rather than just sit on Themberchaud’s back.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin mutters the giant saying, "To save the village, you must smash the village."
source_quote: Thorin mutters an old giant saying, "To save the village, you must smash the village."

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices Duergar panic upon seeing Daz, mistaking the party for the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: They recognized us. Look at their panic. They weren’t afraid of Themberchaud but when they saw Daz, they suddenly freaked out. They think we are the Ember Vanguard.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir suggests exploiting the Duergar’s belief that the party is the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: They think we are this all-powerful group; we take advantage of it.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir concludes that killing the Duergar Stone Guard is necessary to avoid mass bloodshed.
source_quote: In the interest of avoiding mass bloodshed, I think we must.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir recalls that spellcasters who can cast Mending are rare because navies kill them first.
source_quote: spell casters who could cast mending were in high demand by the navies. And so spellcasters tended to avoid learning that spell. See, in naval combat, the first person you kill is the mender. Because until you kill him, you can’t sink the ship. So finding a spell caster who can cast it is rare.

subject: Gartokkar
fact: Gartokkar warned the party that everyone in Gracklstugh is on edge.
source_quote: Gartokkar has warned us that everyone is on edge.

subject: Gartokkar
fact: Gartokkar is referenced as a source of warning about the state of Gracklstugh.
source_quote: Gartokkar has warned us that everyone is on edge.

subject: Errde
fact: Errde is a captain who will be warned about the party’s presence by the Duergar Stone Guard.
source_quote: I must warn Captain Errde at once!

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar bets an empty shell gem that the circle of joy will become a circle of unwilling vows.
source_quote: I'll bet you an empty shell gem that this circle of joy will reveal itself to be a circle of unwilling vows before you leave it.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar throws a rope to catch Grygum after he falls off Themberchaud.
source_quote: Jimjar throws a rope and catches the falling orc.

subject: Rump-a-dump
fact: Rump-a-dump insists the Neverlight Grove cannot be corrupted because their sovereign would not allow it.
source_quote: Zalthir, the circle cannot be corrupted. “Our sovereign would never let that happen.”

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith is compelled to go to the Neverlight Grove by the same force that drew him to the Myconids in the Whorlstone Caverns.
source_quote: The strange compulsion that drew him to the dancing Myconids in the Whorlstone Caverns draws him to the grove.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth will demand to see what the party found, and sharing it will trigger violence.
source_quote: We have passes, but Eldeth will demand to see what we found. And if we share with her what we found, that will trigger violence.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth expresses surprise that Grygum can cast Mending.
source_quote: Eldeth looks at him, “Really?”

subject: Duergar
fact: The Duergar treat Themberchaud as a glorified lighter for their forges.
source_quote: he's merely a "glorified lighter" for the Duergar forges.

subject: Duergar
fact: The Duergar at the forge roll their eyes at Themberchaud’s self-importance.
source_quote: The Duergar are rolling their eyes. They don’t take him as seriously as he takes himself.

subject: Duergar
fact: The Duergar panic and rush to send warnings when they see Daz, believing the party to be the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: they suddenly freaked out. They think we are the Ember Vanguard. ... many of the Duergar rushing around as if they are trying to send warnings.

subject: Ember Vanguard
fact: The Ember Vanguard is a powerful mercenary group feared by the Duergar and the Grey Ghosts.
source_quote: They think we are the Ember Vanguard. ... the Ember Vanguard, the powerful mercenary group, and the Grey Ghosts are looking for the Ember Vanguard

subject: Grey Ghosts
fact: The Grey Ghosts are searching for the Ember Vanguard in Gracklstugh.
source_quote: the Grey Ghosts are looking for the Ember Vanguard

subject: Deep King
fact: The Deep King is worried about the Ember Vanguard’s presence in Gracklstugh.
source_quote: the Deep King is worried.

subject: dead grey ghosts
fact: Dead grey ghosts litter the streets of Gracklstugh.
source_quote: The dead grey ghosts litter the street

subject: bloodsucking giant mosquitoes
fact: Bloodsucking giant mosquitoes fall from the roof on the third day of travel.
source_quote: some bloodsucking giant mosquitoes fall from the roof.

subject: Laduguer's Furrow
fact: Laduguer's Furrow has barred gates that require a clever and insane scheme to escape.
source_quote: Any escape will require some "clever and insane scheme" to get through the barred gates of Laduguer's Furrow.

subject: Darklake District
fact: The Darklake District is a destination the party wishes to reach, but Themberchaud initially refuses to go there.
source_quote: we agree that the right place to go is the docks. ... Themberchaud is unimpressed - and roars - “My agents have more pressing matters than to loiter among the common rabble and petty traitors of the Dark Lake.”

subject: docks
fact: The party lands on the docks of Gracklstugh, where a Duergar Stone Guard confronts them.
source_quote: As we land on the docks, everyone flees except one lonely Duergar Stone Guard who stands in front of us.

subject: Lost Tomb of Khaem
fact: The Lost Tomb of Khaem is a destination the party plans to visit before going to the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: Perhaps we could first go to the Lost Tomb of Khaem, secure whatever weapon it has, and then go?

subject: Neverlight Grove
fact: The Neverlight Grove is a dangerous location inhabited by a mighty demon, according to Zalthir.
source_quote: I explain that there is a very dangerous and mighty demon there, and that we might not want to go there at all.

subject: Whorlstone Caverns
fact: The Whorlstone Caverns are where Sarith previously encountered dancing Myconids.
source_quote: The strange compulsion that drew him to the dancing Myconids in the Whorlstone Caverns draws him to the grove.

subject: caltrop
fact: Grygum gives a caltrop to the Duergar Stone Guard as a symbol of their mission.
source_quote: Grygum pulls out a caltrop, “This is a symbol of our mission. Guard it and keep it secret.”

subject: empty shell gem
fact: Jimjar bets an empty shell gem on the outcome of the party’s journey to the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: I'll bet you an empty shell gem that this circle of joy will reveal itself to be a circle of unwilling vows before you leave it.

subject: demon egg
fact: The party carries the secret of a corrupted dragon egg from Gracklstugh.
source_quote: The secrets we carried - of the Deep King’s plots, the corrupted dragon egg, and the lurking demonic plots - could have provoked mass death and destruction.

subject: demonic plots
fact: The party carries the secret of lurking demonic plots from Gracklstugh.
source_quote: The secrets we carried - of the Deep King’s plots, the corrupted dragon egg, and the lurking demonic plots - could have provoked mass death and destruction.

subject: Deep King’s plots
fact: The party carries the secret of the Deep King’s plots from Gracklstugh.
source_quote: The secrets we carried - of the Deep King’s plots, the corrupted dragon egg, and the lurking demonic plots - could have provoked mass death and destruction.

subject: 4th-6th day of the 2nd tenday of Myrtul 1493
fact: The first two days of travel are uneventful, occurring on the 4th to 6th day of the 2nd tenday of Myrtul 1493.
source_quote:
## 4th-6th day of the 2nd tenday of Myrtul 1493

### Thorin 

The first two days are uneventful.

subject: 7th day of the 2nd tenday of Myrtul 1493
fact: On the 7th day of the 2nd tenday of Myrtul 1493, Sarith announces they must leave the boat and proceed on foot.
source_quote:
## 7th day of the 2nd tenday of Myrtul 1493

On the fourth day, Sarith announces that we must get out on a beach and head deeper into the Underdark on foot.

subject: Themberchaud landing
fact: Themberchaud lands with a shuddering impact resembling a bag of potatoes.
source_quote: Themberchaud lands with a shuddering impact. The landing lacks any of the grace of a dragon. It looks like a bag of potatoes that landed and the bag barely broke.

subject: party boarding Themberchaud
fact: The party climbs onto Themberchaud’s back and takes flight.
source_quote: We all clamber onto his voluminous back, easily finding space. Themberchaud takes off with a powerful beat of his wings

subject: Themberchaud breathing fire at forge
fact: Themberchaud breathes fire at a forge while declaring himself the Wyrmsmith.
source_quote: he approaches the forge and shouts, “I am Themberchaud the Wyrmsmith, bringer of flame!” And he breathes fire.

subject: Grygum falling off dragon
fact: Grygum falls off Themberchaud when the dragon makes a sharp turn.
source_quote: But he’s fast, and his belly rolls instead of gliding, and then I am falling. ... I notice Grygum and Thorin falling.

subject: Jimjar saving Grygum
fact: Jimjar throws a rope to catch Grygum and pulls him back onto Themberchaud.
source_quote: Jimjar throws a rope and catches the falling orc. And then the group pulls him onto the dragon

subject: Zalthir sprouting wings
fact: Zalthir sprouts wings and catches Thorin after the dragon’s sudden turn.
source_quote: Zalthir has sprouted wings. He catches Thorin.

subject: Grygum accepting Jimjar’s bet
fact: Grygum accepts Jimjar’s bet regarding the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: but Grygum does.

subject: party scuttling boat
fact: Grygum suggests scuttling the boat before leaving it on the beach.
source_quote: Gyrgum shouts, “We could scuttle it.”

subject: party leaving Gracklstugh
fact: The party departs Gracklstugh by boat after securing their objectives.
source_quote: As we leave Gracklstugh, we debate where to go next.

subject: Duergar Stone Guard fleeing
fact: The Duergar Stone Guard runs off after accepting the caltrop from Grygum.
source_quote: The Duergar takes the caltrop and then runs off.

subject: party boarding boat
fact: The party jumps into a large boat and sets sail after the encounter with the Duergar Stone Guard.
source_quote: We jump into a large boat and head out.

subject: party leaving boat at beach
fact: The party leaves the boat on a beach to proceed on foot toward the Lost Tomb of Khaem.
source_quote: Sarith announces that we must get out on a beach and head deeper into the Underdark on foot. ... We must leave the boat here.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool wants to go to the Neverlight Grove with the party.
source_quote: Rump-a-dump and Stool want to go to the Neverlight Grove.
